subject: alleles set to zero with genind2genalex

messages.author: 76cf40f90081b985
messages.subject: alleles set to zero with genind2genalex
parts:
Dear all, 
I am having some issues with converting a genlight object to a genalex file... My genind object was imported as a VcfR with the option return.alleles=TRUE. It includes 111 individuals, 1808 loci (2612 alleles). There are some missing genotypes coded as NAs; individuals that are homozygous for an allele score as 2 for that allele, and heterozygous score as 1 (for two alleles), and missing genotypes as NA. 
When I convert it to the genalex format using genind2genalex, however, all alleles are set to zero. 
Has anyone encountered this issue?

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] alleles set to zero with genind2genalex
parts:
Hello,

If only missing genotypes are converted to zero, that's normal, but if ALL genotypes are converted to zero, then there is likely a bug.

I have a couple of questions that may help narrow down what is happening:

1. If you try to convert a subset of your data  (e.g. 5 individuals over three loci), do you still see zeroes for alleles?
2. If you answered yes to the above question, what happens when you run genind2df() on that subset of data? Do you also get zeroes for the alleles?

All the best,
Zhian

dput(monpop[1:5, loc = 1:3]) 
#| new("genclone", mlg = c(260L, 179L, 169L, 168L, 167L), tab = structure(c(1L, 
#| 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 1L, 0L, 
#| 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 
#| 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 1L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 
#| 0L, 0L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L), .Dim = c(5L, 12L
#| ), .Dimnames = list(c("A004", "A002", "A011", "A009", "A006"), 
#|     c("CHMFc4.224", "CHMFc4.231", "CHMFc4.238", "CHMFc5.85", 
#|     "CHMFc5.97", "CHMFc5.111", "CHMFc5.105", "CHMFc5.107", "CHMFc5.113", 
#|     "CHMFc12.163", "CHMFc12.159", "CHMFc12.169"))), loc.fac = structure(c(1L, 
#| 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 3L, 3L, 3L), .Label = c("CHMFc4", 
#| "CHMFc5", "CHMFc12"), class = "factor"), loc.n.all = c(CHMFc4 = 3L, 
#| CHMFc5 = 6L, CHMFc12 = 3L), all.names = list(CHMFc4 = c("224", 
#| "231", "238"), CHMFc5 = c("85", "97", "111", "105", "107", "113"
#| ), CHMFc12 = c("163", "159", "169")), ploidy = c(1L, 1L, 1L, 
#| 1L, 1L), type = "codom", other = list(), call = .local(x = x, 
#|     i = i, j = j, loc = ..1, drop = drop), pop = structure(c(1L, 
#| 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L), .Label = "7_09_BB", class = "factor"), strata = structure(list(
#|     Pop = structure(c(1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L), .Label = c("7_09_BB", 
#|     "26_09_BB", "26_09_FR", "7_09_FR", "26_10_BB", "45_10_BB",

From there, I'll see if I can recreate the issue and track down the bug.

Best,
Zhian
